messages:
nina: hi all, nina here (data infra)  day 1. trying to finish the cloud quickstart but hitting two blockers: (1) can't assume the org role in AWS eu account via CLI (works in console), (2) my new GCP project says billing not linked. who should I loop in?

infra-bot: welcome @nina! tag @jordan (infra) for account roles and @billing for payment links. onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/cloud-access

jordan: hey @nina. quick Qs: which AWS flow works in console but not CLI? are you using Okta SAML->AWS roles or direct IAM user? Also paste the CLI error for assume-role.

nina: console switch-role works when I pick the role dropdown, but running `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::777777777777:role/OrgDevRole --role-session-name nina-test` returns `AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole`

carla: common cause: our SAML mapping provides a temporary web session and console role switch, but the CLI requires the principal to have `sts:AssumeRole` permission on the source principal or to use an IAM user/role that can assume. If you signed up through Okta, you might be using a federated session that doesn't grant CLI token by default.

jordan: also check whether your identity is mapped to the role ARN in the relying-party trust. Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to see the principal you're using in CLI.

nina: `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns: { "UserId": "ABCD:5234", "Account": "999999999999", "Arn": "arn:aws:sts::999999999999:assumed-role/Okta-User/nina" }

carla: that suggests the CLI is using an assumed role name `Okta-User` without the required permission to assume the EU org role. Two fixes: (A) use the aws-vault/okta-aws-cli flow that exchanges SAML for CLI creds that include role ARNs, or (B) infra can add an explicit trust for your okta principal to assume OrgDevRole for onboarding. Which would you prefer?

nina: aws-vault sounds fine but I tried and got MFA prompt failures. our org enforces MFA via Okta push and aws-vault isn't picking it up.

jordan: clear. security note: we enforce MFA for CLI assume too. If aws-vault isn't working we'll do a short-lived explicit grant. Please open INFRA-9001 with caller id and exact CLI command and tag @carla @security. Include duration (we usually do 8h for onboarding).

nina: opened INFRA-9001 and attached CLI error and caller id. asked for 8h assume-role to test quickstart.

billing: @nina for GCP billing links we need the project id and cost-owner approval. If this project was created by the onboarding flow it should attach automatically, otherwise finance must relink. What is the project id?

nina: project id `redwood-data-sbx-eu`. Console shows banner: "This project is not linked to a billing account" and I can't create buckets.

jordan: infra check: sometimes projects created during Okta provisioning land in a holding folder without billing. We'll confirm org-folder and billing account. Can you run `gcloud projects get-billing-info redwood-data-sbx-eu --format=json` and paste output?

nina: can't run it (403). screenshot uploaded to INFRA-9001 and I included the project id.

carla: infra will look at both tickets. Likely steps: (1) for AWS we add a short-lived trust allowing your Okta principal to assume OrgDevRole for 8h, (2) for GCP billing we'll ask finance to relink to PA-210 after approval. If the project was created under a partner billing account we may need owner cooperation.

security: small reminder: any temporary CLI grants will require you to accept extra audit logging and confirm you won't access prod keys. We'll add an audit tag to the grant. Also, please use MFA and avoid saving creds locally.

nina: thanks. timeline? I need to finish quickstart tests today if possible.

jordan: I'll triage INFRA-9001 now and try to push an 8-hour trust by EOD. For GCP billing I'll open FIN-7765 referencing your project id and ask finance to prioritize since it's onboarding.

billing: FIN-7765 created and linked to INFRA-9001. Please include manager approval and note it's for onboarding verification. Expected turnaround 1 business day for relink, faster if manager approves.

nina: added manager approval to FIN-7765. thanks for the quick help. If infra adds the trust, how will I get creds?

jordan: we'll DM temporary instructions (either a pre-signed assume-role CLI snippet or a short-lived role session via the console). We'll post a confirmation here when done.

nina: awesome  appreciate the help! :raised_hands:

infra-bot: INFRA-9001 and FIN-7765 assigned. Keep thread updated.
